Interview Notice
With reference to the Advertisement Notice No: F (ANRF-CBT Project)KU/2026, dated: 27-03-
2026 under the ANRF-sponsored research project “Bioprospection of Western Himalayan
Wormwood (Artemisia L.) Germplasm for Characterisation and Isolation of Artemisinin
(Anti-Malarial Drug), and its Biogenetic Precursors and other Novel Secondary
Metabolites”, the interview for the Research Associate-I position is scheduled to be held in the
office chamber of Head, Department of Botany on Thursday, 16-04-2026 at 02:00 PM.
Furthermore, no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
Sd/
